messages:
maria_seo: Heads-up — pre-launch checklist for tomorrow's webinar landing and blog post. Need sign-off on canonicalization, redirect map for legacy pages, schema for the webinar, and internal linking anchors. Can we triage owners?

devin_pm: I'll own the webinar schema + structured data snippets. Will draft JSON-LD and post here by EOD.

elaine_web: I can handle the redirects. Please drop the list of old URLs and target slugs; I'll run through the netlify/_redirects style rules and the server-side 301s.

sam_analytics: I'll wire up UTMs and the lead routing mapping to HubSpot. Need final canonical URLs before I push tracking. Also add GA4 event names.

maria_seo: Key priorities: 1) canonical headers for duplicate docs (both /docs and /blog variants exist) 2) redirect sweep for old campaign pages 3) internal anchor plan to funnel keyword clusters to pillar content 4) schema on webinar page (Event + FAQ) + speakership markup.

chris_ops: Any constraints on redirects? We should avoid wildcards that catch query strings unintentionally. Elaine, can you share example rules you plan to deploy?

elaine_web: Example rules I'll propose: 
```
# Netlify _redirects
/old-product/(.*)  /product/$1  301!  
/campaign/2023-offer  /offers/summer-2026  301
```
And server nginx style for internal redirects when needed:
```
rewrite ^/old-blog/(.*)$ /blog/$1 permanent;
```
Will run through staging first.

devin_pm: For JSON-LD I'll include Event + organizer and nested FAQ. Quick sample snippet I'll expand: 
```
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "Event",
  "name": "Redwood Inference Launch Webinar",
  "startDate": "2026-04-08T16:00:00Z",
}
```
Will attach full payload with Q&A fields.

maria_seo: Internal linking anchors: aim to add 3 contextual links from docs pages into the new pillar: keywords = ["LLM inference costs", "inference latency tuning", "dedicated GPU pools"]. Short anchor phrasing requested — keep natural.

sam_analytics: For lead routing: form on webinar page should post to HubSpot list id=67890 and set property 'acquisition_channel' = 'webinar_launch_apr26'. I'll also add hidden fields for keyword cluster and utm_source.

maria_seo: Timeline: schema draft by devin by 6pm, redirect list to elaine by 6pm, internal anchor PRs by noon tomorrow, analytics wiring by EOD. If anyone sees blockers reply here. :thumbsup:

elaine_web: Redirect list — dropping initial pass here:
- /resources/old-inference-guide -> /docs/inference-best-practices
- /blog/perf-tuning-2022 -> /blog/inference-latency-tips
- /campaign/llm-costs -> /pricing/optimize-inference
I'll format into _redirects file and include staging preview link.

devin_pm: Schema draft uploaded: https://drive.redwood/example-schema-draft (preview). Please comment inline.

sam_analytics: Added event names: webinar_register, webinar_submit, webinar_confirm. Will map them to HubSpot funnel events.

maria_seo: Quick note on canonical: for pages that have both /blog and /docs variants, canonicalize to the docs version when content is reference/guide-like, blog remains non-canonical. I'll add a spreadsheet mapping tonight.

chris_ops: One more ops note — when we deploy redirects, please include X-Robots-Tag: noindex on any temporary staging redirects to avoid indexing.

maria_seo: Great. If no objections I’ll finalize the spreadsheet and tag owners. Thanks team! :rocket:
